pages.title: Diggosaur
pages.creator: Mariozaur Studios
pages.description:
Diggosaur follows a small dinosaur searching underground for Grandpa Bruno, who disappeared while trying to save a drying spring. Dig through soil, ice, magma, and crystal caves, gathering ores, fossils, and pages from his journal. The discoveries connect the excavation to the search for what happened to him.

Above ground, expand the village with facilities such as a garden, furnace, dojo, and museum. Twelve dinosaurs with different abilities can be unlocked, alongside pets, puzzles, and a balloon trip to Fern Island. The game has no combat and saves progress automatically, letting the digging and village development continue between visits.

pages.title: Sand Loop
pages.creator: Puzzlemaster
pages.description: Collect colored sand from pictures in Sand Loop. Guide buckets along the conveyor so each one can catch sand of the right color. Watch the grains fall and see how removing one section changes the picture above the belt. Keep working through the colors until the sand art has been collected.

pages.title: Bus Color Jam
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Get passengers onto buses of the same color in Bus Color Jam. Check who's waiting and which buses can take them before you make the next move. Send the right groups through and keep the station from getting backed up. Later levels give you more colors and timing decisions to manage.

pages.title: Cute Kitty Merge
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Drop cat pieces and merge them in Cute Kitty Merge. Aim each drop so matching cats can touch and become a larger piece. Check the next piece before you choose a spot, and keep room above the pile as it grows. Try to build larger cats and improve your score without filling the play area.

pages.title: JUMPER
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Bounce from platform to platform in JUMPER. Watch for traps along the climb and collect power-ups that help you reach a new height. A good landing sets you up for the next bounce, so keep an eye on the route above. Unlock skins and earn achievements as you improve your record.

pages.title: Crazy Stunts 3D
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Take a car over ramps and extreme tracks in Crazy Stunts 3D. Line up jumps and work through the available modes, including competition with other players. Clear challenges to unlock more cars. Try a new vehicle on a route you've already driven and see how it handles the ramps.

pages.title: Squad Assembler
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build a squad from equipment and interchangeable body parts in Squad Assembler. Merge weapons and armor to improve their stats, then fit your fighters with different arms, heads, and torsos. Open loot boxes for equipment and hire heroes for harder battles. See how the squad holds up once you send it against the enemy.

pages.title: Evony The King's Return
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Lead soldiers against waves of zombies in Evony The King's Return. Keep your formation moving and shoot the numbered gates to grow the army. Continue firing to get better weapons and give your troops more firepower against the next wave. Watch the route ahead as you choose which gates to attack.

pages.title: 2048 Merge Circle
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Rotate a circle and shoot numbered balls into it in 2048 Merge Circle. Line up a shot so it reaches another ball with the same value, then watch the pair merge into a larger number. Check where the next ball can fit before firing. Keep combining matching values until you reach 2048.

pages.title: Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Tap groups of matching blocks in Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game. Two or more of the same kind can be smashed together. Look at where the remaining pieces will sit afterward so you can set up a bigger combination. Clear the board and try to build a higher score through the matches you choose.

pages.title: Quizmania: Trivia game
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Answer questions across different subjects in Quizmania: Trivia game. Work through levels that get more difficult and use a hint when you're unsure about an answer. Read each choice carefully before you commit. Save some help for later questions if you can solve the current one on your own.

pages.title: Monsterella Fantasy Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create three monster-inspired looks in Monsterella Fantasy Makeup. Try neon lipstick and bright eye shadow on Frankie, jewel tones on Clawdeen, and darker makeup on Draculaura. Choose hairstyles and outfits to finish each makeover. Give each character a look that fits her style without repeating the same combination.

pages.title: Shop Sorting 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Sort groceries and household goods in Shop Sorting 2. Arrange products into matching groups while making room for the other items on the shelves. Unlock new products and upgrade the store's layout as you progress. Each new assortment gives you a different set of goods to organize.

pages.title: Pixel Fun Color By Number
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Fill numbered squares to reveal pixel art in Pixel Fun Color By Number. Choose a picture, then use each square's number to find its color. Work through small areas of the image and watch them join up. Try the city scene and see the street come into view as you finish it.

pages.title: Superhero Phone Simulator
pages.creator: PixelBro
pages.description: Customize a hero and try different activities in Superhero Phone Simulator. Explore its minigames, which include racing and creative challenges, and switch between them when you want a different task. Try another look for your hero before heading into the next challenge. The phone brings the activities together in one place.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess Avater Castle
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Create an underwater home for mermaids in Mermaid Princess Avater Castle. Try outfits on the characters and decorate the spaces they live in. Change the look of a room or the mermaids as you work on the world around them. Put the characters and scenery together the way you want.

pages.title: Knee Case Simulator
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help Tiara recover from a knee injury in Knee Case Simulator. Work through the treatment activities first and follow the steps that help her get better. Once the care is finished, give her a makeover. The two parts of the game take her from the knee case to a new look.

pages.title: Mushroom blocks
pages.creator: Wit Games
pages.description: Collect mushroom blocks and try to keep the round going in Mushroom blocks. Watch for frozen cells, bombs, and lightning as you build your score. Think about which areas of the board still give you room to move when an obstacle gets in the way. Compare your points with the rankings after a run.

pages.title: Art Master Origins
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Color paintings by number in Art Master Origins. Work through pieces by Polish artists and collect painting trophies from different art movements. Look at the details as you fill each numbered area. The game also gives you a chance to compare artworks and distinguish a forgery from a genuine piece.

pages.title: Airways Maze
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Draw a route for a plane in Airways Maze. Start on the left and drag a path toward the right side without passing through the blocks. Look at how much room the plane will have around each turn. Get it across safely to unlock the next layout.

pages.title: Letters Match
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear letters by making pairs and special combinations in Letters Match. Select letters horizontally, vertically, or diagonally and look for identical pairs or combinations listed in the magic dictionary. Check what each match leaves behind before choosing the next one. The goal is to clear the playing field.

pages.title: Brain Puzzle Tricky Choices
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Look for an unexpected solution in Brain Puzzle Tricky Choices. Read the scene and choose what should happen next to resolve the situation. A choice that sounds obvious can leave you looking for another answer, so pay attention to the story around it. Solve each scenario to move on.

pages.title: Football Stars Championship
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Spin a football slot machine to advance a duel in Football Stars Championship. The spins drive the match, and a shooting minigame gives you a chance to add points by getting a shot past the goalkeeper. Work through the leagues and collect trophies as your results improve.

pages.title: Hexa Sort 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sort and merge stacks of hexagonal tiles in Hexa Sort 3D. Think about which colors you can bring together before placing another stack. A merge can free space for pieces that didn't fit before. Read the board after each move as the later levels give you more stacks to organize.

pages.title: Winter CosmoFest
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style a couple for a winter cosplay festival in Winter CosmoFest. Take inspiration from Honkai characters as you choose makeup, costumes, hairstyles, and accessories. Try pieces together to see how they fit the snowy setting. Give each cosplayer an outfit that draws on a different character or style.

pages.title: Block Wood Puzzle 2
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fit wooden shapes into the board in Block Wood Puzzle 2. Drag and drop each piece where it can help fill a row. Completing one row scores points, while clearing two or more together earns a bonus. Leave useful spaces open so you can fit the next shape when it appears.

pages.title: Slime Invader
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Defend against slimes coming from multiple directions in Slime Invader. Use the arrow keys to control your defense and watch which group is getting closest. Improve the cannon's damage, shot speed, rate, or number of shots, or restore the shield when you need protection. Keep the invaders from overwhelming you.

pages.title: Hexa Block Puzzle
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Fit clusters of colored blocks into a larger hexagon in Hexa Block Puzzle. Drag each piece into a blank space that fits its shape. Look at the gaps a placement will leave before you drop the piece. Keep arranging the clusters to clear blocks and build your score.

pages.title: Zombie Mission 12
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Rescue hostages in the Wild West in Zombie Mission 12. Use weapons, vehicles, and support from drones or robot horses as you work through the missions. Fight bosses and spend your earned coins on upgrades at the store. Two players can coordinate their moves and cover different parts of the mission.

pages.title: Knight 360
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Stop moving to swing your sword in Knight 360. The knight attacks in a circle when standing still, so step into position and wait for the blade to catch nearby ghosts and skeletons. A swing can also knock away arrows. Clear each level by timing when to move and when to stand your ground.

pages.title: Gameloft Solitaire
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Work through a trip around the world one card layout at a time in Gameloft Solitaire. Follow the onscreen directions to learn how to move the cards. Look at the options each layout gives you and choose plays that open up more cards. The journey continues as you solve the boards.

pages.title: Goalkeeper Wiz
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Move the gloves with the mouse and save shots in Goalkeeper Wiz. Your opponent gets ten attempts in each match, and every three saves earn your team a goal. Read the path of each shot before moving the gloves. Help your team through the tournament and aim for the world title.

pages.title: Spot 5 Diffs Urban Life
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare two city scenes in Spot 5 Diffs Urban Life. Click the details that have changed and use a hint if a difference is hard to find. Look at matching parts of the pictures so you can spot smaller changes. The sooner you finish, the bigger the time bonus you can earn.

pages.title: JUMP ON 2
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Tap to climb without falling in JUMP ON 2. Keep track of the clock and pick up items that extend your time. Hit switches to make coins appear, then collect what you can as you move upward. Spend the coins on skins for future runs.

pages.title: Aquatic Word Search
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find aquatic words hidden in the grid in Aquatic Word Search. Press the first letter and drag in a straight line to the last one. Words can run across, down, or diagonally in either direction. Check the list on the left and find each entry to complete the level.

pages.title: Move The Pin 2
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Get colored balls into a glass in Move The Pin 2. Pull pins in an order that lets the balls through, and use colored bombs to turn gray balls into usable ones. Watch for bombs and pointed pins that can destroy the balls. Look over the layout before opening the first barrier.

pages.title: Crab & Fish
pages.creator: Atatapp
pages.description: Free trapped fish by guiding a crab through each stack in Crab & Fish. Click blocks to remove them from beneath the crab, and think about where it will land before taking out another one. Keep the crab balanced while lowering it toward the fish. Reach and release the fish to complete the rescue.

pages.title: Basketball Kings 2022
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Make baskets in four street courts in Basketball Kings 2022. Line up shots and keep scoring to set a higher record. Unlock other basketballs when your scores are high enough, then see how you do with a different one. Try the other locations when you want a change of court.

pages.title: Digitz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Combine neighboring digits that add up to ten in Digitz! Choose a seven and a three, for example, to remove the pair and uncover their squares. When no available pair adds to ten, new digits appear in open spaces. Use the new numbers to keep making sums and clear the playing field.

pages.title: Zombie Hunt
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Tap zombies before they reach you in Zombie Hunt. Watch the horde as it comes in and shoot whichever enemies are closest to getting through. Move your attention around the screen as more zombies approach. Keep the defense going and see how long you can stop them from closing in.

pages.title: Super Drive Ahead
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Ram rival vehicles in Super Drive Ahead. Choose a car and use the physics of each collision to take on opponents, including trucks and tanks. Collect coins for vehicle upgrades and buy power-ups to help in the arena. Work through more than 50 levels and try different rides as you go.

pages.title: City Constructor Driver 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Deliver bricks to construction sites in City Constructor Driver 3D. Drive the truck to move the materials, then tap to speed up the building work once the delivery is done. Each mission involves both transport and construction. Finish the job to move on to another project in town.

pages.title: Impostor Rescue Online
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Pull pins to get impostors out of danger in Impostor Rescue Online. Study what each pin separates before opening a route through the ship. Pulling the wrong one can kill the character, so think about the order of your moves. Save the other impostors and unlock skins as you solve more levels.

pages.title: Crayz Monster Taxi Halloween
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Drive a monster truck taxi through a Halloween course in Crayz Monster Taxi Halloween. Use the gas to keep the vehicle balanced as you cross the rough road. Pick up coins when you can reach them and make it to the finish without overturning. Try to finish quickly while keeping the taxi under control.

pages.title: Halloween Puzzle
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Fit groups of blocks onto the board in Halloween Puzzle. Drag pieces into open spaces and fill a complete horizontal or vertical line. Look at what gaps will remain before you put a shape down. Clearing a line gives you more space to work with when you place the next group of pieces.

pages.title: Pixel Cat Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Connect identical cat pictures in Pixel Cat Mahjong. Find two matching tiles and check that a line can link them before making the pair. Work quickly, since the timer gives you only a short while to clear the layout. Keep looking for connections as other tiles disappear.

pages.title: Miner Rush
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Mine materials on the move in Miner Rush. Cut through trees, gather minerals, and steer clear of obstacles along the 3D course. Pick a path that gives you time to collect useful resources without slowing you too much. Reach the finish quickly and see how much your mining adds to the score.

pages.title: Happy Cups 2
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Fill different cups without spilling in Happy Cups 2. Open the tap and estimate how much liquid each container can hold. Watch its shape before you decide when to stop the flow, since the cups have different capacities. Fill each one to the right level to move on.

pages.title: Max Pipe Connect
pages.creator: IzelgueGames
pages.description: Connect pipe sections to carry water in Max Pipe Connect. Examine the pipe ends and arrange a continuous route before letting the water through. Look for loose ends or breaks that would let it leak out. Work through the layouts by linking each section to the next.

pages.title: Space Heroes Match
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Match tiles to power heroes in Space Heroes Match. Each color gives the corresponding hero energy to fire at enemy ships. Look for groups you can clear quickly while the countdown runs. Keep feeding the heroes' attacks and try to build the highest score you can before time runs out.

pages.title: Atari Centipede
pages.creator: Atari
pages.description: Defend the bottom of the screen with a bugblaster in Atari Centipede. Shoot the segmented centipede before it reaches you, while watching for spiders, scorpions, and fleas. A hit turns a segment into a mushroom and can leave other pieces moving on their own. Keep firing and see how long you can survive.

pages.title: Santa Claus Rush
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Jump past incoming rockets and collect presents in Santa Claus Rush. Watch what's approaching before going for a gift, since staying alive lets you collect more along the way. Time your jumps so Santa can get past each rocket and continue the run. Try to bring back more presents on your next attempt.

pages.title: Siren Head Sound of Despair
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search for a missing husband in Siren Head Sound of Despair. The story starts at a campsite near Belgrade in 1999, where he disappears overnight. Explore the surroundings and look for a way to survive once Siren Head appears. Keep searching while the creature threatens your route.

pages.title: Fortune Cookies
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Make a batch of fortune cookies in Fortune Cookies. Work through the cooking steps to prepare the cookies and place a paper fortune inside. Use the customization choices to finish the batch the way you want. Follow the recipe from the ingredients to the completed cookies.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Dinosaur
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color dinosaur pictures in Easy Kids Coloring Dinosaur. Pick a drawing and use the mouse or touch to fill it in. Give the dinosaur its own colors, then decide how to color the smaller details around it. Try another picture or return to a favorite with a different palette.

pages.title: Stickman Fighter 3D Fists Of Rage
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight through five locations in Stickman Fighter 3D Fists Of Rage. Start on the highway and work your way through the city, hospital, military base, and port. Use the arrows to move, Z and X to punch and kick, and C to block. Jump with Space as you tackle the 100 levels.

pages.title: Mini Ninja
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Keep a ninja out of danger in Mini Ninja. Tap to react when an obstacle comes into the ninja's path. Pay attention to the distance between hazards so you're ready for the next move. Stay alive as long as possible and see if you can beat your high score.

pages.title: Survival Wave Zombie Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight zombies, soldiers, and other players in Survival Wave Zombie Multiplayer. Choose modes such as Survival, Gun Game, team deathmatch, or deathmatch, and play with friends in multiplayer. Use the mouse to aim, shoot, and switch weapons. Try different camos and attachments to change your weapons between fights.

pages.title: Cat Doctor Sim
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Care for sick cats as a veterinarian in Cat Doctor Sim. Use the mouse to work through the treatment activities and help each cat as the game directs. The cases continue across several levels. Complete the current visit before seeing which cat needs your help next.

pages.title: Basketball Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Throw a basketball toward the hoop in Basketball Challenge. Use the mouse or touch to take a shot and watch where the ball goes. Adjust the next throw if the ball falls short or goes past the basket. Make the shot to score and move on to another level.

pages.title: Old City Stunt
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take a sports car or armored vehicle into an abandoned city in Old City Stunt. Race against the clock to clear levels and unlock another car, or explore in Free Driving mode. Use nitro when you have room to accelerate. Share the keyboard with a second driver to take on the city together.

pages.title: Garbage Trucks Hidden Trash Can
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find ten hidden trash cans in each picture in Garbage Trucks Hidden Trash Can. Scan the truck and the details around it, then click each can you spot. The timer keeps running as you search, so move on if a section is holding you up. Find all ten to finish the scene.

pages.title: Air Race
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Fly through a busy airspace in Air Race. Click or touch the movement controls to guide your plane around enemy aircraft. Watch where the other planes are headed and steer toward an open part of the screen. Pick up fuel along the way and try to stay airborne long enough to improve your score.

pages.title: Pink Roses Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble pictures of anime girls with pink roses in Pink Roses Puzzle. Choose one of six images and decide whether to use 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Match parts of the flowers and surrounding scene as you build the picture. Try a larger piece count for a more detailed version.

pages.title: XMAS Wheelie
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Keep a wheelie going in XMAS Wheelie. Hold the mouse button or your finger down to lift the front wheel. Watch how far the rider leans and adjust so the bike stays balanced. See how much ground you can cover on the back wheel before the attempt ends.

pages.title: Winter Clash 3D
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Play as Santa in the team shooter Winter Clash 3D. Fight the elves and capture the Pagan Idol on a deserted lighthouse island. Bring it to the Christmas fire and burn it before the elves can carry out their plan. Move with WASD and use the mouse to aim at threats along the way.

pages.title: Yamaha 2020 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide picture pieces into place in Yamaha 2020 Slide. Choose one of three Yamaha motorcycle images and one of the three puzzle modes. Compare bits of the bike and background to tell where the sections belong. Work through the arrangement until the complete motorcycle picture is visible.

pages.title: Breaker Manga Girls
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Break bricks to uncover manga illustrations in Breaker Manga Girls. Keep the ball in play with the paddle and send it into the blocks still covering the picture. Watch the return angle after each hit so you can get underneath the ball. Clear the bricks to reveal what's behind them.

pages.title: Fruit Blocks Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Arrange falling fruit to form matching lines in Fruit Blocks Match. Shift the group left or right and shuffle its order before it lands. Matches can run across, down, or diagonally. Look for a landing that clears fruit and keeps the pile from reaching the top row.

pages.title: Funny Monsters Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Put together pictures of monsters in Funny Monsters Jigsaw. Choose one of 12 images and play with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Find sections that line up across neighboring pieces and use them to rebuild the scene. Try the same monster on a harder setting when you want more pieces to sort.

pages.title: Alien Invasion
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Defend Earth from attacking aliens in Alien Invasion. Watch the screen for enemies approaching from several directions and move before they close in. Use the arrow keys and Space or play by touch. Take out the invaders as they enter the fight and try to keep the defense going.

pages.title: Pony Pet Salon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Give a pony a different look in Pony Pet Salon. Use the mouse to browse the pony skins and try the available styling choices. See how a different pony changes the look you want to make. Keep the combination you like or return to the salon to try another one.

pages.title: Princess Spring Fashion Show
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style Elisa and her models in Princess Spring Fashion Show. Choose an evening dress and shoes or try a bodysuit from the collection. Add jewelry, a clutch, and makeup to finish each model's outfit. Bring the looks together before the spring show begins.

pages.title: Monster Truck
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive different trucks through the levels in Monster Truck. Use W and S to move and A and D to rotate the truck. Adjust its angle when it needs to clear an obstacle or land on uneven ground. Restart with R if you want to take another run at the level.

pages.title: Little Strawberry
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Guide a strawberry past a series of blades in Little Strawberry. Use the mouse or tap the screen to move it and watch for a gap in the next set of blades. Time the move so the fruit passes through without being cut. See how many blades you can clear in one attempt.

pages.title: Xtreme Paintball Wars
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Battle with paintball guns in Xtreme Paintball Wars. Aim and fire with the mouse, switch weapons with the number keys, and press R to reload. Try the different game modes against computer-controlled opponents or other players. Move through the blocky arenas and watch for incoming paint as you line up a shot.

pages.title: EG Street Skater
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Manage your speed and jump over obstacles in EG Street Skater. Use the left control to change speed and the right one to jump. Watch what is coming down the street so you can prepare for the next jump. The pace increases as you go, leaving less time to react.

pages.title: Easter Eggs in Rush
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Match three or more eggs in a row in Easter Eggs in Rush. Clearing a group adds time to the meter, but the clock keeps counting down as you look for the next match. Use the mouse and pick a move quickly when a group is ready to clear. Keep adding time while you build your score.

pages.title: EG Tom Runner
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Help a postman get away from a dog in EG Tom Runner. Click or tap at the right moment to move up or down as he runs. Watch how the chase changes as the speed increases. Keep reacting in time to stop the dog from catching him.

pages.title: Princess Easter Celebration
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get an Easter party ready in Princess Easter Celebration. Help the prince invite the princess, then choose an egg and decorate it for the occasion. Pick an outfit for the princess after the egg is ready. Put the look and the decoration together before the celebration begins.

pages.title: Diamond Match
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Swap jewels to make matches in Diamond Match. Look for diamonds you can bring together, then check the new arrangement after they clear. Choose Classic or Arcade mode and work through the levels. Use each swap to open a move that will help with the remaining pieces.

pages.title: Spider Fly Heros
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a flying superhero through a side-scrolling course in Spider Fly Heros. Use the mouse to gain height and make room to pass obstacles and enemies. Collect coins when there's a clear route to them. Watch the space ahead before changing height so you don't fly into the next hazard.

pages.title: Cube Endless Jumping
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Climb as high as you can in Cube Endless Jumping. Steer the cube left or right as it jumps and collect food for more points. Watch the birds and balloons as you climb, since landing on them from above can add to your score. Keep going upward to improve your result.

pages.title: Reversed GP
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Drive against traffic on a circular track in Reversed GP. Tap to switch between lanes when a car comes toward you. Keep an eye on the other cars, since they can change lanes too. Try to keep moving around the track and improve your score without a head-on crash.

pages.title: Spike Dodge
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Control the speed of a green ball in Spike Dodge. Hold the screen to slow it down and let go to speed it up. Watch the direction the spikes are flying and adjust the ball's pace so they miss it. See how long you can keep dodging and raise your score.

pages.title: Princess Salon Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give a princess a makeover in Princess Salon Day. Try makeup styles and choose the one you want to keep, then move on to her hands and nails. Pick a nail color that goes with the look you created. The salon takes you through both parts of the makeover.

pages.title: Mahjong Deluxe 2
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pair identical tiles to clear boards in Mahjong Deluxe 2. Look for available matches, then check which tiles their removal opens up. Keep working through the layout until all the tiles are gone. Try to finish quickly while leaving useful choices for the next move.

pages.title: Stickman Army : Team Battle
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Lead a squad in Stickman Army : Team Battle. The soldiers carry different weapons and have different abilities, so choose when to attack, defend, or use a special move. Watch what the opposing squad is doing before you commit. Use the strengths of the soldiers you have to defeat the enemy team.

pages.title: Blondie World Tour
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style a pop singer for four concert destinations in Blondie World Tour. Pick a stop and work on a hairstyle and outfit for the performance. Try a different combination when the tour moves to another location. Give each show its own look as you prepare the singer for the stage.

pages.title: Surprise Eggs Princess Star
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Open chocolate eggs to reveal the toys inside in Surprise Eggs Princess Star. Work through the levels by opening the eggs one at a time. Each shell hides a surprise, so see what you find before moving on to the next egg. Keep opening them to discover more of the toys.

pages.title: Super Sticky Stacker
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Attach objects to one another in Super Sticky Stacker. Think about where each new piece will stick and how its weight might affect what's already in place. Arrange the objects so the group stays together without dropping. The challenge is finding a place for every piece that keeps the structure balanced.

pages.title: BFFs Makeup Time
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Make over two friends in BFFs Makeup Time. Try glittery eye shadow, glossy lipstick, and other cosmetics before choosing a look for each girl. Then move to the dressing room and pick clothes that go with their makeup. Give the friends different styles or match details across their outfits.

pages.title: Bake Time Hot Dogs
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Make hot dogs to order in Bake Time Hot Dogs. Check what each customer wants, put the order together, and serve it quickly to earn a bigger tip. Keep an eye on the next order while finishing the current one. Earn enough money to pass the level and keep serving.
